import json
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('Y','O','S','N','r') and n['pixels']<40:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.setdefault(n['color'], []).append((n['pixels'], min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)))
    return out
print('before:', snap())
for (r,c,label) in [(56,42,'Y'), (56,12,'O'), (56,27,'S')]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(label, 'after:', snap(), 'done:', last_action_result.get('done'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
